description: Integration tests run against the emulator service in isolation (no scenario-to-desktop dependency). Cover: create VNC session, create headless session with DISPLAY returned, launch an app from explicit `app_path`, take screenshot, tail metrics, destroy session. Plus a CLI smoke test exercising `session list/create/destroy/exec/logs`. See research/emulator-extraction-and-service-plan conclusion Findings 11 and 13.
name: emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1
title: Phase 1 acceptance tests for vrooli-emulator
